question: What is the name of India's first polycentric prosthetic knee developed by IIT - Madras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kadam** is the name of India's first polycentric prosthetic knee developed by IIT - Madras.
 
• This innovative prosthetic knee is designed to provide better mobility and comfort to amputees.
 
• IIT - Madras has been at the forefront of technological advancements and this development marks a significant achievement in the field of prosthetics.
 
• The polycentric design allows for a more natural gait and improved stability for the user.
 
• The initiative is part of the institute's ongoing efforts to create affordable and high-quality healthcare solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IIT - Madras** is one of the premier engineering institutions in India, known for its cutting-edge research and innovation.
 
• The institute has various initiatives aimed at improving the quality of life through technological solutions.
 
• Prosthetic technology has seen significant advancements in recent years, focusing on enhancing the functionality and comfort of artificial limbs.
 
• Collaborations between academic institutions and healthcare providers are essential in developing solutions that are both innovative and practical.
 
• Such developments highlight the importance of research and development in addressing the needs of differently-abled individuals.
